# CBC

> Canada's public broadcaster delivering news, sports, entertainment, and multimedia content across television, radio, and streaming platforms.

CBC.ca serves as the digital hub for Canada's national public broadcaster, offering comprehensive coverage of Canadian and world news, live sports streaming, television and radio programming, and on-demand content through CBC Gem. The platform integrates news aggregation, entertainment, and current affairs across multiple media formats.

## Key Topics

- CBC News
- CBC Sports
- CBC Gem
- Canadian Broadcasting
- News Aggregation
- Live Streaming
- Entertainment News
- Sports News
- Current Affairs
- Marketplace

- Radio Programming
- Video Content
- World News
- Canadian News

## News & Current Affairs

- [CBC News](https://www.cbc.ca/news): CBC News aggregator for Canadian and world news across all categories
- [CBC.ca Homepage](https://www.cbc.ca): CBC homepage with news, entertainment, sports, and multimedia content

## Sports

- [CBC Sports](https://www.cbc.ca/sports): CBC Sports hub with news, video, and live streaming of Canadian sports

## Broadcasting & Streaming

- [CBC Gem](https://gem.cbc.ca): CBC Gem streaming service with shows, films, and live TV content
- [CBC Television](https://www.cbc.ca/television): CBC Television streaming and programming hub with shows and live TV
- [CBC Radio](https://www.cbc.ca/radio): CBC Radio One with news, current affairs, and Canadian programming

## Optional

- [Marketplace - Customer Disservice: Telecom Edition](https://gem.cbc.ca/marketplace/s53e13): Marketplace consumer protection episode on telecom customer service
